The security problem

More signals do not always mean better decisions.

Fragmented assets, isolated alerts, and unclear ownership make it difficult to know what needs attention. Proactive defense connects the environment, the evidence, and the next decision—before an incident defines the priority.

Stay ahead.

Built around your environment.

Enterprises

07 / Designed around decisions

Technical depth, without the mystery.

The product experience is built around explainability and review—not unsupported claims about autonomous protection.

Evidence before conclusions

Every sample finding keeps its source, reasoning, and uncertainty visible. Review the evidence—not just a severity label.

Context before urgency

Asset exposure and business impact help frame a priority. A signal alone is not a confirmed incident.

Ownership before action

A useful recommendation identifies what to verify and who should approve the next step. Automated changes require explicit authority.

Every environment is different. Scope and requirements determine your custom quote.
